body: P1: sevenKeysSnapshot.keys uses uniqueArray(), but the normative JSON Schema only requires exactly seven items and does not declare uniqueItems. This rejects a schema-valid document and makes the validator stricter than the fixed contract. Use z.array(...).length(7), leaving only improved_keys/worsened_keys unique.
author: Codex

replies.body: Resolved in the staged diff: keys now uses z.array(...).length(7), and a regression test proves the validator accepts the exact seven-item shape permitted by the normative schema. Focused PrjOps suite: 381 passed.
